description.value: You're a natural leader, adept at bringing people together, settling arguments, and guiding a group toward a common goal. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Group Impression] skill feat.
